desc:
💀 Welcome to Steal a Skeleton Egg! 💀

🎮 How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from sleeping skeleton guards
🏃 Run back to your base before they catch you
⚰️ Bury your egg in your graveyard and hatch a rare skeleton
🗼 Your skeletons climb your tower and JUMP: every 💥 SMASH makes you money! 💰
⬆️ Upgrade your tower and graveyard to fit more skeletons
⚡ Train your speed to unlock new zones
🌈 Find rare skeletons, giant sizes and 🥇 Gold, 🥈 Silver and 🌈 Rainbow mutations!

🎁 Free gifts every few minutes, daily rewards and live events!
👍 Like the game and join the group for a FREE gift!
📱 Play on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet 💻
